en: The postcard features a panoramic black-and-white view of a historic city with mountainous terrain in the background. Prominently in the foreground are the ruins of ancient columns, likely from a monumental structure. The card is labeled in three languages (Greek, French/English, and perhaps transliterated Greek), mentioning 'Athènes' (Athens), 'Boulevard Olga', and a Greek phrase. The general tone of the photograph and font suggests an early 20th-century origin.
